headline: Colombia Central Bank Holds Interest Rate at 12.25% in Divided Vote
summary: Colombia's central bank maintained its benchmark interest rate at 12.25% following a divided vote, amid a core inflation rate of 6.0%.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions anchor borrowing costs, shape yield curves, and influence foreign exchange flows in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Maintaining the policy rate at 12.25% keeps domestic benchmark borrowing costs unchanged.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The decision to hold rates steady at 12.25% matched policy expectations while signaling a cautious stance amid persistent inflation.
